source: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo press release: Notice Regarding Completion of Pyeongtaek Plant at Korean (09-15-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: TOK completed construction of the Pyeongtaek Plant (Gyeonggi Province, South Korea) at its Korean subsidiary TOK Advanced Materials (TOKAM) on September 15, 2026 - the group's second production site in South Korea and its first high-purity chemical production site there. Phase 1 is a high-purity chemical manufacturing building with cleanroom areas for cutting-edge semiconductor manufacturing, plus warehouses and ancillary facilities (total floor area approximately 6,300 m2); operations are scheduled to start in the first half of 2027. Company: under its 'local production for local consumption' model it will continue to actively consider capital investments to expand its production base as the semiconductor market expands; the impact is already reflected in the consolidated forecasts announced on August 6, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: investment approximately ¥12.0 billion; approximately 6,300 m2; operations scheduled for first half of 2027
